title: Dragon Pearl
synopsis: A story about a filial son who accidentally consumes a dragon pearl.

fullText.simplified:
龙珠

    从前，在四川，有一对母子住在河边，他们以种田为生。那年天热无雨，草都黄了。
    一天，儿子捡到了一颗龙珠。龙珠很神奇，可以变出很多米和很多钱。他把米和钱送给邻居，邻居们很开心。
    坏人听说了，就来抢这颗龙珠。儿子把龙珠放在嘴里，一不小心，吃了下去。
    吃了龙珠后，儿子觉得口渴。他喝了很多水，直到喝干了所有河水。突然，儿子的头上长出了角……他变成了龙！
    “妈妈，再见！”龙说，可是他知道他们不会再见了。妈妈哭了，龙也哭了。
    龙的泪水变成大雨，河边的草都绿了。龙跳进河里，游走了。妈妈叫：“儿子！”龙回头看了看妈妈。
    妈妈叫了二十四次，龙回头看了二十四次。每次回头，河边就出现一个河滩。一共二十四个河滩，所以当地的人们叫这个地方“望娘滩”。
fullText.traditional:
龍珠

    從前，在四川，有一對母子住在河邊，他們以種田為生。那年天熱無雨，草都黃了。
    一天，兒子撿到了一顆龍珠。龍珠很神奇，可以變出很多米和很多錢。他把米和錢送給鄰居，鄰居們很開心。
    壞人聽說了，就來搶這顆龍珠。兒子把龍珠放在嘴裡，一不小心，吃了下去。
    吃了龍珠後，兒子覺得口渴。他喝了很多水，直到喝乾了所有河水。突然，兒子的頭上長出了角……他變成了龍！
    “媽媽，再見！”龍說，可是他知道他們不會再見了。媽媽哭了，龍也哭了。
    龍的淚水變成大雨，河邊的草都綠了。龍跳進河裡，游走了。媽媽叫：“兒子！”龍回頭看了看媽媽。
    媽媽叫了二十四次，龍回頭看了二十四次。每次回頭，河邊就出現一個河灘。一共二十四個河灘，所以當地的人們叫這個地方“望娘灘”。

sentences.traditional: 媽媽叫：“兒子！”龍回頭看了看媽媽。

Altogether, there were 24 shoals, so the locals called this place the “Mother Gazing Shoals”.

raw.synopsis: A story about a filial son who accidentally consumes a dragon pearl.
sentence_translations: Once upon a time, in Sichuan, there was a mother and son who lived on a riverbank. They farmed to make a living.
That year, it was hot and there was no rain. The grass had turned yellow.
One day, the son picked up a dragon pearl.
The dragon pearl was very mystical. It could produce lots of rice and lots of money.
He gave the rice and money to his neighbors, and his neighbors were all very happy.
Bad people heard about this and came to snatch the dragon pearl.
The son put the dragon pearl inside his mouth, and accidentally swallowed it.
After swallowing the dragon pearl, the son felt thirsty.
He drank lots of water, until he had drunk dry all the water in the river.
Suddenly, horns grew out of the son’s head … he had become a dragon!
“Mom, until next time!” The dragon said, but he knew that they would not see each other again.
His mom cried. The dragon also cried.
The dragon’s tears became heavy rain, and all the grass on the riverbank became green.
The dragon jumped into the river, and swam away.
His mom cried out, “My son!” The dragon turned his head back to look at his mom.
His mom cried out 24 times, and the dragon turned his head back to look 24 times.
Every time he turned his head back to look, a shoal appeared on the riverbank.
Altogether, there were 24 shoals, so the locals called this place the “Mother Gazing Shoals”.
